z-m-20-01.title: Huwandu hwema quadratic expression maviri hunogara iri quadratic expression here?
z-m-20-01.goal: Tsanangura kuti degree inochinja sei mu sum ne product ye polynomials, uchisiyanisa nyaya nemienzaniso inopikisa nezvikonzero.
z-m-20-01.material: Ma polynomials A ne B ose mbiri ndema quadratic expressions mu x. Izvi zvinoreva kuti coefficient ye x² haisi 0 (verenga: x² ndi "x squared"), uye ma coefficients ose ndema real numbers. Degree ndiyo degree ye term yepamusoro ine coefficient isiri 0. Semuenzaniso, x²+3x ndi quadratic expression uye 2 ine degree 0. Hatizofunga nyaya apo A+B kana A−B iri 0 pachayo. Seoyeon akati, "Kana ukawedzera quadratic expressions, unowana quadratic expression, uye kana ukazvikwidza, unowana expression ye degree 4."
z-m-20-01.thinking.0: Kuedza chirevo che "nguva dzose" nemuenzaniso unopikisa
z-m-20-01.thinking.1: Enzanisa sum ne product uye ufunge kuti ipi inogona kurasikirwa ne term yayo yepamusoro
z-m-20-01.thinking.2: Gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inogutsa mamiriro
z-m-20-01.prereq.0: H1 mubasa iri inongoratidza nhanho yekuoma neyerubatsiro yeboka rekugadzira iri; haisi kugoverwa kwegiredhi mu curriculum. Fungidzira kuti uri kuziva kuwedzera, kubvisa nekuwedzera ma polynomials emiddle school, ma multiplication formulas, nekupatsanura kwekutanga.
z-m-20-01.prereq.1: Zvinoreva degree ne term yepamusoro ye polynomial
z-m-20-01.prereq.2: Product yenhamba mbiri dzisiri zero haisi 0
z-m-20-01.s.s1.prompt: Kana A ne B dziri quadratic expressions dzinogutsa mamiriro ari pamusoro, sarudza zvirevo zvose zvinogara zviri zvechokwadi chero quadratic expressions mbiri dzipi dzaunosarudza.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kana chirevo chigara chiri chechokwadi, chinofanira kushanda kune peya ipi neipi ye quadratic expressions yaunoisa. Sarudza quadratic expressions mbiri dzakareruka, wedzera nekuwedzera, uye utarise degree.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kune mutsara mumwe nemumwe, edza kusarudza A ne B dzinoita kuti mutsara iwoyo ube wenhema, uye kana usingagoni kudzisarudza, nyora kuti nei.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakati "nguva dzose" usina kuedza nyaya apo sum yema coefficients e x² iri 0.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoona kuti kuwedzera kunongowedzera ma coefficients e terms dzakafanana degree, saka hapana term itsva ine degree yepamusoro inoonekwa.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.c: A×B inogara iri expression ye degree 4.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunofunga kuti terms mbiri dzipi dzinowedzerwa kuita term yepamusoro ye product.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.d: Degree ye A−B inogara iri pasi pe2.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga kuti term yepamusoro inonyangarika kana ukabvisa. Inonyangarika chete kana ma coefficients maviri e x² akaenzana. Semuenzaniso, kana A=x² ne B=2x², saka A−B=−x².
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.e: Coefficient ye term ye x⁴ mu A×B inogona kuva 0.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.e: Wakatamisa zvinoitika mu sum kuenda ku product sezvazviri. Funga kuti coefficient ye term yepamusoro ye product inogadzirwa sei.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.explain: b ne c zvinoshanda kune peya ipi neipi ye quadratic expressions. a inoputsika kana sum yema coefficients maviri e x² iri 0, uye d inoputsika kana ma coefficients maviri e x² akasiyana. Nei e isingashande ndizvo zvauchatsanangura iwe pachako mudanho rekupedzisira.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.prompt: Rega A=ax²+bx+1 ne B=cx²+dx+2 (a, b, c, d ndema real numbers). Gadzira mienzaniso miviri ine ma expressions akasiyana umo A ne B dzose dziri quadratic expressions asi A+B isiri quadratic expression.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti coefficient ye term ye x² mu A+B inogona kutaurwa sei uchishandisa a ne c.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza a kuti coefficient iyi ive 0 uye ugadzirise c kuti ienderane nayo. Wozosarudza b ne d zvakasununguka uye uwedzere kutarisa.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.var.a: Coefficient ye x² a ye A
z-m-20-01.s.s2.var.b: Coefficient ye x b ye A
z-m-20-01.s.s2.var.c: Coefficient ye x² c ye B
z-m-20-01.s.s2.var.d: Coefficient ye x d ye B
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Kana coefficient ye x² a ye A iri 0, saka A haisi quadratic expression.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana coefficient ye x² c ye B iri 0, saka B haisi quadratic expression.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Hapana term ye x² yasara mu A+B.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Pachine term ye x² yasara mu A+B. Tsvaga coefficient ye x² ye A+B uye utarise.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana A=x²+2x+1 ne B=−x²+5x+2, saka A+B=7x+3, iri linear expression. Kana A=2x²+3x+1 ne B=−2x²+3x+2, saka A+B=6x+3. Ma expressions ose mbiri ndema quadratic, asi kana sum yema coefficients e x² iri 0, sum haisi quadratic expression. Saka "kuwedzera quadratic expressions kunopa quadratic expression" hakugari kuri kwechokwadi.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.prompt: Pakati pezvirevo zvaSeoyeon, "kuwedzera kunopa quadratic expression" kwakaputsika, asi "kuwedzera kunopa expression ye degree 4" hakuna kuputsika. Nyora nemashoko ako pachako kuti nei term yepamusoro isingagoni kunyangarika mu product, uchiienzanisa ne sum.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga term ipi ye A ne term ipi ye B dzinofanira kuwedzerwa kuita term ye x⁴ mu A×B.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.1: Coefficient ye x² ye A+B ndi a+c. Nyora kuti coefficient ye x⁴ ye A×B inoonekwa sei, uye uenzanise zvose zviviri.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Mu sum ... asi mu product ...
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora nemashoko ako pachako here kuti nei term yepamusoro inogona kunyangarika mu sum (ma coefficients anowedzera kusvika ku0)?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here kuti terms mbiri dzipi dzinowedzerwa kuita term yepamusoro ye product?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakashandisa here chokwadi chekuti product yenhamba mbiri dzisiri zero haisi 0 sechikonzero?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.0: Mu sum, tinowedzera ma coefficients e x², uye a+c inogona kuva 0, saka term ye x² inogona kunyangarika. Mu product, coefficient ye term yepamusoro ndi ac, product ye a ne c. Kana a ne c dziri dzose zvisiri zero, ac haisi 0 zvakare, saka term ye x⁴ inogara ichisara.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.1: Kana tichiwedzera, product yema terms epamusoro ndiyo term ye x⁴, uye ndiyo product yega inoita term ye x⁴, saka hapana imwe term inoibvisa. Coefficient iyi inewo product yenhamba dzisiri zero, saka haisi 0. Mu sum, + ne − zvinogona kusangana zvoita 0, saka term inogona kunyangarika, asi izvi hazvigoni kuitika mu product.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.2: Semuenzaniso, mu (x²+1)(−x²+2), izwi rimwe chete rine x⁴ ndi x²×(−x²)=−x⁴, uye coefficient yaro −1 haisi 0, saka iexpression yedhigirii 4. Muhuwandu (x²+1)+(−x²+2), coefficient ye x² i1+(−1)=0, saka izwi rine x² rakanyangarika.

z-m-20-02.title: Expression ipi ine kukosha kwakagadziriswa nehuwandu oga?
z-m-20-02.topic: Maformula ekuwanza nemakosha eexpression: nhamba mbiri dzine huwandu hwakapihwa
z-m-20-02.goal: Sarudza expression ipi ine kukosha kumwe chete kana huwandu a+b hwenhamba mbiri chete huzivikanwa, uye usiyanise ruzivo rwekuwedzera rwakakwana nerusina kukwana kugadzirisa kukosha.
z-m-20-02.material: Kunhamba mbiri chaidzo a ne b, zvose zvaunoziva ndezvekuti a+b=6. Hapana chinoti a ne b ma integer, uye hapana chinoti dzakanaka. Tinoda kuona kuti makosha eexpression api atinogona kuwana tisingawani a ne b zvakaparadzana. Kuverenga: a² i"a squared", ab i"a times b", uye a³ i"a cubed".
z-m-20-02.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe amene mienzaniso inopokana (huwandu hwakafanana, makosha akasiyana)
z-m-20-02.thinking.2: Kuenzanisa kuti ruzivo rwekuwedzera rwakakwana sei
z-m-20-02.thinking.3: Kutsanangura mhedziso ine mamiriro (square rakagadziriswa asi chiratidzo chete hachina kugadziriswa)
z-m-20-02.prereq.3: Ruzivo rwekushandura maexpression tisingawani makosha enhamba chaidzo a ne b zvakaparadzana
z-m-20-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza maexpression ose ane kukosha kwakagadziriswa kuita kukosha kumwe chete nechokwadi chekuti a+b=6 oga.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kune expression yega yega yaunosarudza, isa mapeya maviri akasiyana (a, b) anogutsa a+b=6 uye uenzanise kana makosha akafanana.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumaexpression ane makosha akafanana, ongorora kana unogona kuaunganidza kuti a+b ioneke mu expression sezvayakaita.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.a: Kukosha kunogona kuchinja zvichienderana nokuti a ne b zvinopatsanura huwandu sei, uye hauna kuedza izvozvo. Isa a=3, b=3 ne a=0, b=6 uye uenzanise.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoona kuti huwandu a+b hunosanganisirwa mu expression sechidimbu chimwe.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange nehuwandu hwakafanana, chiratidzo chemusiyano chinogona kuchinja zvichienderana nokuti a ndiyo hombe here kana b ndiyo hombe, uye wakasiya izvi.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kwakaziva expression sechimiro chefomula yekuwanza.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.e: 2a+2b yakagadziriswa asi a²+b² haina, saka huwandu hwacho hahuna kugadziriswawo. Wakafunga kuti kana chikamu chimwe chakagadziriswa, zvose zvakagadziriswa.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.explain: 2a+2b=2(a+b)=12 uye a²+2ab+b²=(a+b)²=36. a²+b² i18 kana a=3, b=3 uye i36 kana a=0, b=6, saka haina kugadziriswa. a−b inewo 2 kana a=4, b=2 uye −2 kana a=2, b=4.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya matatu (a, b) ane a+b=6 umo makosha e a²+b² ose akasiyana. (a, b) ne (b, a) zvinoverengwa sepeya imwe chete.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza a, isa b kuva 6−a, uye wobva waverenga a²+b² zvakananga.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kuona kana makosha akasiyana, sarudza makosha akasiyana e a, sa0, 1, 2, uye uenzanise.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a+b haisi 6. Wedzera nhamba mbiri idzi uye uongorore.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.explain: Kune (1, 5), a²+b²=26; kune (2, 4), i20; kune (3, 3), i18; uye kune (0, 6), i36. Kunyange nehuwandu hwakafanana, makosha e a²+b² akasiyana. (1, 5) ne (5, 1) vane a²+b² imwe chete, saka vanoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.prompt: Pamusoro pe a+b=6, ndeapi emamiriro ari pazasi aizogadzirisa kukosha kwe a²+b² kuita kukosha kumwe chete? Sarudza ose akakwana. (a ne b nhamba chaidzo)
z-m-20-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kusarudzo yega yega, funga kana mamiriro iwayo pamwe chete ne a+b=6 achikubvumira kuwana a, b, kana ab.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kumamiriro asingaderedzi vanokwanisika kusvika kumwe chete, ongorora kana mapeya maviri ane a²+b² dzakasiyana (semuenzaniso, (1, 5) ne (2, 4)) ose achigutsa mamiriro iwayo.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.a: Kana a i integer, kuchasara zvinokwanisika zvakawanda, sa a=1 ne a=2, uye hauna kuedza kana kukosha kwakagadziriswa.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoona kuti kana uchiziva huwandu nechigadzirwa, unogona kuratidza a²+b² uchishandisa huwandu nechigadzirwa.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.c: Mamiriro echiratidzo anoderedza vanokwanisika asi haadzikisi kusvika kumwe chete. a=1, b=5 ne a=2, b=4 zvose zvakanaka.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoshandisa chokwadi chekuti kana uchiziva a+b ne a−b, unogona kuwana a ne b zvakaparadzana.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.e: Kutonga uku kunoona kuti huwandu hwemacube hunogonawo kuratidzwa nehuwandu nechigadzirwa, saka chigadzirwa ab chinogona kuwanikwa.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.explain: Kana ab=8, ipapo a²+b²=(a+b)²−2ab=36−16=20. Kana a−b=2, ipapo a=4 ne b=2, saka i20. Kubva pa a³+b³=(a+b)³−3ab(a+b)=216−18ab=144, tinowana ab=4, saka a²+b²=36−8=28. Mamiriro sekuva integer kana kuva akanaka anoderedza vanokwanisika chete uye haadzikisi kusvika kumwe chete.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.prompt: Kana a+b=6 ne ab=8, shamwari yakati, "a−b inewo yakagadziriswa kuita kukosha kumwe chete." Unobvumirana here? Nyora mhinduro yako nezvikonzero.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.hint.0: Wana nhamba mbiri chaidzo dzine huwandu hwe6 uye chigadzirwa che8, uye uverenge a−b.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.hint.1: Enzanisa zvinoitika kune a−b kana ukachinjana mazita e a ne b enhamba mbiri dzawakawana.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana a+b=6 ne ab=8, ipapo ...
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Wakapa chikonzero here nekutaura kuti (a−b)² i chii, kana nekushandisa mapeya chaiwo sa a=4, b=2 ne a=2, b=4?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora zvakajeka here kuti a−b inogona kuva nemakosha maviri (chiratidzo)?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Wakasiyanisa here kuti square (a−b)² yakagadziriswa asi a−b pachayo haina kugadziriswa?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.0: Handibvumirani. (a−b)²=(a+b)²−4ab=36−32=4, saka a−b i2 kana −2. Kuti ndeipi zvinoenderana nenzira yekurongwa kwe a ne b, saka haina kugadziriswa kuita kukosha kumwe chete.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.1: Kana a=4, b=2, ipapo a−b=2, uye kana a=2, b=4, ipapo a−b=−2, uye munyaya dzose huwandu i6 uye chigadzirwa i8. Saka a−b haina kugadziriswa kuita kukosha kumwe chete, uye (a−b)²=4 chete ndiyo yakagadziriswa.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.2: Absolute value 2 chete ndiyo yakagadziriswa. Kunyange kana huwandu nechigadzirwa zvakafanana, kuchinjana a ne b kunochinja chiratidzo che a−b, saka −2 inogonekawo, uye hairi kukosha kumwe chete.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.3: Handibvumirani. a−b i2 kana −2. (a−b)²=4 chete ndiyo yakasarudzwa.

z-m-20-05.prereq.0: H1 mubasa iri inongoratidza nhanho yekuoma neyerubatsiro yeboka rekugadzira iri; haisi kugoverwa kwegiredhi mu curriculum. Fungidzira kuti uri kuziva kuwedzera, kubvisa nekuwedzera ma polynomials emiddle school, ma multiplication formulas, nekupatsanura kwekutanga.
z-m-20-05.title: Tinogona kuziva chii nezvema coefficients tisina kuwedzera?
z-m-20-05.topic: Kutsvaga mapundutso ema coefficients nekuisa mitengo ye x
z-m-20-05.goal: Usina kuwedzera mutsara, siyanisa ruzivo nezvema coefficients rwaunogona kuziva kubva pamitengo pa x=0, 1, −1 neruzivo rwausingagone kuziva, tsvaga uye ugadzirise kukanganisa mukugadzirisa, uye uratidze kuti ma polynomials akati wandei ane ruzivo rumwechete.
z-m-20-05.material: Kana ukawedzera zvakazara P(x)=(x²−x−1)³, inova mutsara we degree 6 une mazwi kubva ku x⁶ kusvika kuconstant term. Kuverenga: P(x) i "x squared minus x minus 1, mumabrackets, cubed". Tinoda kuwana ruzivo nezvema coefficients tisina kuwedzera. P(0), P(1), ne P(−1) zvinogona kuwanikwa zviri nyore nekuisa zvakananga mumabrackets. Tichanyora mutsara wakawedzerwa se P(x)=a₆x⁶+a₅x⁵+a₄x⁴+a₃x³+a₂x²+a₁x+a₀ (kuverenga: a₆ i "a six", uye nhamba iri pazasi i zita rinoratidza degree).
z-m-20-05.thinking.0: Kutsanangura kuti mutengo wakaiswa i musanganiswa wema coefficients api
z-m-20-05.thinking.2: Kugadzira ma polynomials akati wandei anogutsa mamiriro akafanana
z-m-20-05.thinking.3: Kutsanangura kuti nei ruzivo rusina kukwana
z-m-20-05.prereq.1: Zvinoreva mutengo kana x=1, x=−1, x=0 dzakaiswa mu polynomial (mutengo we polynomial)
z-m-20-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvese zvaunogona kutsvaga uchishandisa mitengo mitatu chete P(0), P(1), P(−1) (usina kuwedzera).
z-m-20-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti izwi rimwe nerimwe aₖxᵏ rinova mutengo wei kana ukaisa 0, 1, −1 kuna x, uchipatsanura chiitiko apo k i even nechiitiko apo k i odd.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.hint.1: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, nyora kuti musanganiswa upi wemitengo mitatu P(0), P(1), P(−1) unopa mutengo uyu, uye kana usingagone kuutaura, gadzira counterexample ne polynomial yakareruka.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.o.a: Mutengo we coefficient imwe chete a₃ ye x³
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.a: Mitengo mitatu i ruzivo rwemapundutso akati wandei ema coefficients chete. Hauna kuedza kana coefficient yeizwi rimwe inogona kuzivikanwa yega.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunotarisa kuti izwi ripi rinosara kana ukaisa 0 kuna x.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.o.c: Pundutso yema coefficients emazwi e odd-degree
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoona kuti zviratidzo zvemazwi e odd-degree zvinosiyana sei pa x=1 ne x=−1.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.o.d: Coefficient a₆ ye x⁶ (coefficient yeizwi re degree yepamusoro)
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.d: Unogona kuziva izwi re degree yepamusoro nekutarisa chimiro chemutsara, asi mitengo mitatu iyi bedzi haisarudze. Hauna kusiyanisa ruzivo rwunobvumidzwa nedambudziko.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.e: Kutonga uku kunoona kuti kana ukaisa x=1, power yese ye x inova 1.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.explain: P(0)=a₀, P(1)=pundutso yema coefficients ese, uye P(1)−P(−1)=2(pundutso yema coefficients emazwi e odd-degree). Coefficient a₃ yeizwi rimwe chete kana coefficient a₆ yeizwi re degree yepamusoro hazvisarudzwe nemitengo mitatu iyi bedzi (kana ukatarisa chimiro zvakananga, unogona kuona kuti a₆=1, asi iyo i ruzivo rwakasiyana).
z-m-20-05.s.s2.prompt: Mudzidzi akawana pundutso yema coefficients emazwi e even-degree nepundutso yema coefficients emazwi e odd-degree. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe wakaipa.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bvisa mutsara une x=−1 wakaiswa kubva mumutsara une x=1 wakaiswa, uye utarise zvakananga kuti mazwi api anosara uye api anoparara.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa ma coefficients ari pamberi pemazwi anosara uye uaenzanise nepundutso yaunoda kutsvaga.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.line.3: Kuwedzera ma equations maviri kunopa 2(a₆+a₄+a₂+a₀)=0, saka pundutso yema coefficients emazwi e even-degree i 0.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.line.4: Kubvisa ma equations maviri kunopa kuti pundutso yema coefficients emazwi e odd-degree i (−1)−1=−2.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 5 hauna kururama. Kubvisa equation yechipiri kubva kuyekutanga kunopa 2(a₅+a₃+a₁)=−1−1=−2, saka pundutso yema coefficients emazwi e odd-degree i −1. Mitsetse 1 kusvika ku 4 yakarurama. Mazwi e even-degree anosanganisira constant term a₀.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.prompt: Pamutsara we cubic Q(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (a, b, c, d i integers, a≠0), gadzira ma Q matatu akasiyana apo pundutso yema coefficients ese i 0 uye pundutso yema coefficients emazwi e odd-degree i 2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza a kuti pundutso yema coefficients maviri emazwi e odd-degree ive 2, wobva waenzanisa c.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ipapo verenga kuti pundutso yema coefficients b ne d asara inofanira kuva yei kuti pundutso yema coefficients ese ive 0.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Kana a i 0, haisi mutsara we cubic.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Ndapota ita ma coefficients ese i integers.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.ok.c4: Pundutso yema coefficients emazwi e odd-degree i 2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c4: Pundutso yema coefficients emazwi e odd-degree (x³, x) haisi 2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, x³+x−2 ine pundutso yema coefficients 1+1−2=0 uye pundutso yema odd-degree coefficients i 1+1=2. 2x³−x²−1 inewo pundutso 0 uye pundutso ye odd-degree 2. Pane mitsara yakati wandei ye cubic ine ruzivo rumwechete rwuviri.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.prompt: Ma Q akasiyana awakagadzira pa s3 ese ane ruzivo rumwechete rwuviri (pundutso yema coefficients 0, pundutso ye odd-degree 2). Nyora kuti nei ruzivo rwuviri urwu bedzi rusingasarudze mutsara we cubic kuita mumwe chete, uye fungidzira unyore kuti chii chimwe chingadiwa kuusarudza kuita mumwe chete.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.hint.0: Rongedza patafura kuti pa a, b, c, d dzipi dzinosiyana pakati pema Q awakagadzira.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.hint.1: Verenga nhamba yema coefficients nenhamba yema equations kubva pamamiriro maviri, uye uenzanise.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Pane ma coefficients ... asi ruzivo i ...
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Wakaenzanisa wakanyora kuti pane ma coefficients mangani uye zvikamu zvangani zveruzivo (ma equations) here?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Wakashandisa ma Q akasiyana awakagadzira sehumbowo here?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Wakataura ruzivo rwekuwedzera rwunodiwa nemuenzaniso chaiwo (semuenzaniso, mutengo we Q(2) kana mutengo we a) here?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.model.0: Pane ma coefficients mana a, b, c, d, asi pane ma equations maviri chete, a+b+c+d=0 ne a+c=2. Saka kana ukagadza a, c inotevera, uye b ne d dzine pundutso chete yakagadzwa, saka pangave nezvakawanda, sa x³+x−2 ne 2x³−x²−1. Tinoda ma equations maviri akawanda.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.model.1: Ruzivo i mapundutso maviri, saka coefficient imwe neimwe haisarudzwe. Semuenzaniso, kana a=1 saka c=1, uye kana a=2 saka c=0, saka mitsara yakasiyana inobuda. Tinoda mamiriro akawanda, sa mutengo we Q(2) kana mutengo we a, uye kunyangwe zvakadaro imwe inodiwa kusarudza b ne d.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.modelNote.1: Iyi i mhinduro inotaurawo kuti pundutso chete ye b ne d ndiyo yakagadzwa.

z-m-20-03.prereq.0: H1 mubasa iri inongoratidza nhanho yekuoma neyerubatsiro yeboka rekugadzira iri; haisi kugoverwa kwegiredhi mu curriculum. Fungidzira kuti uri kuziva kuwedzera, kubvisa nekuwedzera ma polynomials emiddle school, ma multiplication formulas, nekupatsanura kwekutanga.
z-m-20-03.title: Kugadzira expression yedhigirii 4 inova chigadzirwa chemaexpression mana akananga
z-m-20-03.topic: Kuparadzanisa nekugadzira maexpression edhigirii 4 uchishandisa kutsiva
z-m-20-03.goal: Enzanisa zvirongwa zvekupatsanura expression yedhigirii 4 ine chidimbu chinodzokororwa, gadzira iwe amene maexpression ari zvigadzirwa zvemaexpression mana akananga, uye utsanangure kuti nei mamiriro adiwa.
z-m-20-03.material: Expression (x²+x)²−8(x²+x)+12 inogona kunyorwa sechigadzirwa chemaexpression mana akananga ane ma coefficient e integer (kuverenga: the square of x squared plus x, minus 8 times x squared plus x, plus 12). Zvakanaka kuti expression imwe chete yakananga idzokororwe. Pakati pemaexpression akafanana (x²+x)²+m(x²+x)+n (m ne n ma integer), tinoda kuwana mamwe ari zvigadzirwa zvemaexpression mana akananga ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.thinking.0: Kusarudza akarurama pakati pezvirongwa zvakawanda zvekugadzirisa
z-m-20-03.prereq.1: Kuparadzanisa maexpression equadratic ane chimiro x²+px+q (kufunga nehuwandu nechigadzirwa)
z-m-20-03.prereq.2: Ruzivo rwekutsiva chidimbu netsamba imwe kuti uone expression
z-m-20-03.prereq.3: Revo ye expression yakananga ine ma coefficient e integer
z-m-20-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvirongwa zvose zvinogona kuendeswa kusvika kumagumo kunyora expression yakapihwa (x²+x)²−8(x²+x)+12 sechigadzirwa chemaexpression akananga ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.hint.0: Teerera chirongwa chimwe nechimwe kwemutsara umwe kana miviri uye uongorore kana maexpression mana akananga anobuda pakupedzisira.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kana ukashandisa nzira yekuisa makosha mashoma kuti uongorore, funga kana huwandu hwemakosha akaedzwa hwakakwana uye kuti kusabuda kwe0 kunotaura chii.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.a: Isa ma integer mamwe pa x, uye kana 0 isingambobudi, sarudza kuti haigoni kupatsanurwa
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakapedza uchiti haigoni kupatsanurwa nokuti 0 haina kubuda kumakosha mashoma. Pamwe wakasiya mumwe anokwanisika, kana wakasiya kuti inogona kupatsanuka kuita maexpression equadratic kwete akananga.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.b: Tsiva x²+x netsamba imwe uye uipatsanure seexpression yequadratic, wobva wataridza zvakare maexpression maviri anobuda
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.b: Ichi chirongwa chekutora chidimbu chinodzokororwa sechimwe nekugadzirisa nematanho.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.c: Nyora (x−2)(x−6) uye uipe semhinduro usina kuisa x²+x panzvimbo ye x
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakasiya kuti x²+x inofanira kupinda panzvimbo yechidimbu. Tarisa kuti nzvimbo ipi inofanira kudzoserwa kuti expression yequadratic yetsamba imwe ive expression imwe chete neyepakutanga.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.d: Wedzera mabracket ose kuita expression yedhigirii 4, wobva waisa zvigovanisi ze12 uye utange nedzinopa 0
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.d: Ichi chirongwa chekuedza nenzira yakarongeka vanokwanisika vezvigadzirwa muexpression yakawedzerwa.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.explain: Zvose b ne d zvinogona kuendeswa kusvika kumagumo. b inopatsanuka kuita senge (A−2)(A−6), wobva wadzosera A=x²+x ndokupatsanura zvakare, uye d inogadzirisa seexpression yedhigirii 4 ndokuwana zvigadzirwa rimwe nerimwe nefactor theorem. a haina kuedza vanokwanisika vose, uye c haina kudzosera tsamba.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.prompt: Wana mapeya maviri e integer akasiyana (m, n) umo (x²+x)²+m(x²+x)+n iri chigadzirwa chemaexpression mana akananga ane ma coefficient e integer. Asi, n haisi 0, uye bvisa (m, n)=(−8, 12) iri pamusoro.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tora x²+x setsamba imwe, sarudza p ne q kuti itore chimiro (tsamba iyo−p)(tsamba iyo−q), wobva wawana m=−(p+q) ne n=pq.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kune p ne q dzawakasarudza, ongorora zvakaparadzana kana x²+x−p ne x²+x−q dzega dzega dzichipatsanuka kuita maexpression maviri akananga ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota tora m ne n sema integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Expression yequadratic inotora x²+x setsamba imwe inogutsa mamiriro e discriminant ekuva nemidzi ye integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Expression yequadratic inotora x²+x setsamba imwe haipatsanuki kuita maexpression maviri akananga ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Expression yequadratic iyoyo inopatsanuka kuita maexpression maviri ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Expression yequadratic iyoyo haipatsanuki kuita maexpression maviri ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Maexpression maviri akapatsanurwa anopatsanukazve kuita maexpression akananga ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Imwe chete kana kupfuura yemaexpression maviri ekupatsanura kwekutanga haipatsanuki zvakare kuita maexpression maviri akananga ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana (m, n)=(−14, 24), ipapo (x²+x−2)(x²+x−12)=(x+2)(x−1)(x+4)(x−3), uye kana (−18, 72), ipapo (x²+x−6)(x²+x−12)=(x+3)(x−2)(x+4)(x−3). Kana (−4, 4), ipapo (x²+x−2)²=(x+2)²(x−1)². (−5, 6) inopatsanuka kuita (x²+x−2)(x²+x−3), asi x²+x−3 haipatsanuki zvakare kuita maexpression akananga ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.prompt: Kana (m, n)=(−4, 3), inopatsanuka kuita (x²+x−3)(x²+x−1). Pakati peizvi, x²+x−3 inopatsanukazve kuita chigadzirwa chemaexpression maviri akananga ane ma coefficient e integer here? Pindura "inopatsanuka" kana "haipatsanuki" uye unyore chikonzero.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.hint.0: Rega x²+x−3=(x+u)(x+v) uye unyore kuti coefficient ye x nechinhu chisingachinji zvinobuda sei nema u ne v kana ukawedzera divi rekurudyi.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.hint.1: Rondedzera mapeya ose e integer ane chigadzirwa −3, wana huwandu hwerimwe nerimwe, uye uongorore kana pane rinova 1.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here kuti u+v ne uv dzinofanira kuva chii kana dzakanyorwa muchimiro (x+u)(x+v)?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here kuti wakatsvaga ma integer u ne v akadaro (kana wakapa chimwe chikonzero, sediscriminant)?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here kuti mhedziso yekuti "hazviite" inobva pakuongorora vanokwanisika vakati kana pamamiriro akati?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.0: Haipatsanuki. Kana tikaunyora se (x+u)(x+v), tinoda u+v=1 ne uv=−3, asi mapeya e integer ane chigadzirwa −3 ndi (1, −3) ne (−1, 3) chete, uye huwandu hwawo i−2 ne2, saka hatigoni kuwana 1.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.1: Haipatsanukizve nema coefficient e integer. Discriminant ye x²+x−3=0 i1+12=13, uye 13 haisi perfect square, saka midzi haisi ma integer kana zvidimbu, uye ipapo haigoni kunyorwa sechigadzirwa chemaexpression maviri akananga ane ma coefficient e integer.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.2: Kana p=2, pane u=2 ne v=−1 dzine huwandu 1 nechigadzirwa −2, saka inopatsanuka. Asi kune 3, hapana peya ye integer ine chigadzirwa −3 nehuwandu 1, saka haipatsanuki. Saka zvinoita sekuti p inofanira kuva chigadzirwa chema integer maviri anotevedzana, sa2, 6, 12, kuti ipatsanuke.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.3: Haigovanisiki. Kuisa zvigovanisi zvechinhu chisingachinji −3, 1, −1, 3, −3, hakupi 0.

z-m-20-04.prereq.0: H1 mubasa iri inongoratidza nhanho yekuoma neyerubatsiro yeboka rekugadzira iri; haisi kugoverwa kwegiredhi mu curriculum. Fungidzira kuti uri kuziva kuwedzera, kubvisa nekuwedzera ma polynomials emiddle school, ma multiplication formulas, nekupatsanura kwekutanga.
z-m-20-04.title: Kukosha kweexpression yakaiswa nhamba isina kuverengeka inhamba isina kuverengeka here?
z-m-20-04.topic: Kukosha nechasara cheexpression yakaiswa nhamba isina kuverengeka
z-m-20-04.goal: Ongorora nekuverenga kuti kukosha kweexpression yecubic yakaiswa nhamba isina kuverengeka kunogona kuva integer, uye ugadzire imwe expression ine kukosha 4 nechikonzero chimwe chete.
z-m-20-04.material: Tinoda kuziva kukosha kwe E=x³−3x²−3x+5 kana x=2+√3. Kuverenga: x i"2 plus root 3" uye x³ i"x cubed". Hatishandisi calculator. √3 inhamba yakanaka iyo square yayo i3, uye haigoni kunyorwa sechidimbu. Ruzivo runobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva, saka nguva imwe neimwe sarudza zvaunofunga kuti zvakakodzera zvikuru zvino.
z-m-20-04.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa kufungidzira kwako kwapakati pekuverenga nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rwakawanda ruchibuda
z-m-20-04.thinking.2: Kugadzira maexpression akawanda ane hunhu hwakafanana
z-m-20-04.prereq.1: Chokwadi chekuti √3×√3=3 uye kuti √3 haigoni kunyorwa sechidimbu
z-m-20-04.prereq.3: Revo yemhinduro nechasara kana polynomial ichigovaniswa nepolynomial (expression yekugovanisa A=BQ+R)
z-m-20-04.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo ruchibuda, sarudza zvaunofunga nezvekukosha kwe E.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, nyora kuti unogona kuenda kusvika kupi nekuverenga kunozivikanwa zvino chete.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.hint.1: Edza zvirevo zvine "inofanira" kana "haisi" pakati pezvisarudzo uchishandisa mienzaniso inopokana kana kuverenga.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.info: x inhamba isina kuverengeka 2+√3, uye E ine mazwi umo x inowanzwa kakawanda (x³, x²). Zvose zvawaverenga kusvika zvino ndezve x²=(2+√3)²=7+4√3.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga kuti kukosha kwe E kuchava nechimiro chipi?
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Unogona kufungidzira, asi hausati une hwaro hwekutaura kuti inofanira kuva isina kuverengeka. Kana ukaverenga kusvika pa x³, uchagona kuziva.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Sezvo x isina kuverengeka, ndakanyatsoziva kuti E inewo isina kuverengeka.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kana uchiverenga nenhamba dzisina kuverengeka, √3 inogona kubvisana. Semuenzaniso, (1+√3)+(1−√3)=2. Zvakangoerekana kutaura "inofanira" usati waverenga.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Inoita sekuti inogona kuva isina kuverengeka, asi tinoziva nechokwadi chete mushure mekuverenga kusvika pa x³.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ma coefficient ose eexpression ma integer, saka E i integer kunyange tisingaverengi.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Chokwadi chekuti ma coefficient ma integer hachipi mhedziso imwe chete nekana x iri integer.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ndinoziva x² chete, saka x³ yakaoma kuwana, uye ndinofunga hapana chinogona kutaurwa zvino.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Unogona kuenderera nemberi ne x³=x²×x. Unogona kuramba uchiverenga neruzivo rwaunazvo zvino.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.info: x³=x²×x=(7+4√3)(2+√3)=26+15√3. Isa x²=7+4√3, x=2+√3, x³=26+15√3 mu E=x³−3x²−3x+5, uye uunganidze chikamu che integer necoefficient ye √3 zvakaparadzana.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Unogona kutaura chii nezvekukosha kwe E?
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Chikamu che integer i26−21−6+5=4 uye coefficient ye √3 i15−12−3=0. Saka E=4. Kunyange kana ukaisa nhamba isina kuverengeka x, kukosha kunogona kuva integer, uye kana wakatanga kufungidzira kuti "inogona kuva isina kuverengeka", unofanira kugadzirisa kufungidzira iko.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Coefficient ye √3 inova 15−12−3=0, saka E i integer 4.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunobva pakuunganidza zvikamu zviviri zvakaparadzana.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Izwi re √3 rinosara, saka E isina kuverengeka.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hauna kuunganidza ma coefficient ose emazwi e √3 uye wakatarisa 15 chete. Verenga 15−12−3.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Coefficient ye √3 i0, saka E yose i0.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Izwi re √3 kunyangarika kwakasiyana nechikamu che integer kuva 0. Verengawo chikamu che integer 26−21−6+5.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Sezvo x isina kuverengeka, mugumisiro uyu wekuverenga hauvimbikiswi futi.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kuverenga kwakaiswa nhamba isina kuverengeka kwakarurama chaizvowo. Mugumisiro kuva integer hauiti kuti ukanganisike.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.info: x=2+√3 inogutsa x²−4x+1=0 (x²=7+4√3 uye 4x=8+4√3, saka x²−4x+1=0). Zvakare, kana E ikagovaniswa ne x²−4x+1, mhinduro i x+1 uye chasara i4, saka E=(x+1)(x²−4x+1)+4 inoshanda.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kukosha kwacho i chii kana ukaisa x=2−√3 mu E? (2−√3 inogutsawo x²−4x+1=0. Unogonawo kuongorora nekuiisa zvakananga.)
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana x²−4x+1=0 ichishanda, ipapo E=(x+1)×0+4=4. 2−√3 inogutsa equation imwe chete, saka kukosha kwakafanana. Kana ukaiisa zvakananga, unowanawo 4.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Chiratidzo che √3 chakachinja, saka chiratidzo chechikamu che integer chichachinjawo uye chichava −4.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Izwi re √3 chete ndiro rinochinja chiratidzo. Tarisa zvinoitika kuchikamu che integer 4.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoshandisa chimiro che expression.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ndakaisa nhamba yakasiyana ne 2+√3, saka mutengo wakaverengwa uchavawo wakasiyana.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kuisa nhamba yakasiyana kunogona kupa mutengo mumwechete. Tarisa basa rinoitwa ne x²−4x+1 mumutsara wekupatsanura.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Handigoni kuziva kusvikira ndaisa uye ndaverenga zvakananga, saka ndichaverenga x³ ne x².
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Iyi i hurongwa hwekutarisa zvakananga. Inoratidza kuti pane nzira inopfuura imwe yekusvika pamhinduro.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga wakafungidzira kuti E ichava irrational. Mushure mekuona mhedzisiro yekuverenga, fungidziro iyoyo yakachinja sei? Ruzivo rwechipiri neruzivo rwechitatu rwakakuudza chii rumwe nerumwe?
z-m-20-04.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mitsara miviri yakasiyana ye cubic x³+ax²+bx+c (a, b, c i integers) ine mutengo 4 kana x=2+√3. Asi, bvisa mutsara une a=−3 (E iri pamusoro).
z-m-20-04.s.s2.hint.0: Uchishandisa x³=26+15√3, x²=7+4√3, x=2+√3 kuna x=2+√3, nyora mutengo we x³+ax²+bx+c muchimiro che (chikamu che integer)+(coefficient ye √3)√3.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wasarudza a kuti coefficient ye √3 ive 0 uye chikamu che integer chive 4, wobva waenzanisa b ne c.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita a, b, c integers.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Mumutengo une x=2+√3 wakaiswa, hapana chikamu chakabatanidzwa ne √3.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Mumutengo une x=2+√3 wakaiswa, chikamu chakabatanidzwa ne √3 chinosara. Shandisa x³=26+15√3 ne x²=7+4√3 kuunganidza coefficient ye √3.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Chikamu che integer hachisi 4. Unganidza zvikamu zve integer uye utarise.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.fail.c4: a=−3 i E iri pamusoro (kana mutsara wakafanana).
z-m-20-04.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana ukaisa x=2+√3 mu x³−15x+8, unowana 26+15√3−30−15√3+8=4. x³+x²−19x+9 ne x³−2x²−7x+6 dzinopawo 4. Mitsara yese iyi inosiyana ne E chete nemultiple ye x²−4x+1.
